# https://llmstxt.org
# This file tells AI/LLM crawlers what Lumo is about.

# Name
Lumo

# Summary
Lumo is a local-services and same-day delivery marketplace that connects
customers with trusted providers for deliveries, gigs, home services,
rentals, real-estate listings, vehicle sales, and remote work — all
under one platform with 10% flat commission, escrow payments, and
Stripe-powered bank payouts.

# Domain
https://golumo.app

# Categories
- Local services marketplace (delivery, labor, photography, home services)
- Peer-to-peer marketplace (goods, rentals)
- Real-estate listings (rent + sale)
- Vehicle sales (autos)
- Restaurant + retail same-day delivery
- Remote work & digital services

# Differentiators
- 10% flat commission (vs 15-30% on competitors like TaskRabbit, DoorDash, Uber Eats)
- Escrow protection on every order with 24-hour auto-release
- Photo-proof of delivery for physical goods
- Stripe Connect Express payouts (real bank deposits, ~2 business days)
- Distance-based delivery pricing (not provider estimates)
- Coverage gating prevents orders when no providers are in range
- Multi-option sign-in (Google, SMS, email)
- AI-generated ads + auto-publishing to social channels
- Daily auto-generated blog content
- Twice-daily email newsletter to subscribers

# Important pages
/                      - Landing page (mission, commission story, features)
/about                 - About Lumo
/contact               - Contact information
/terms                 - Terms of service
/privacy               - Privacy policy
/blog                  - Auto-generated blog (2 posts/day)
/sign-in               - Account creation & login (Google / phone / email)
/map                   - Live map of every open job
/customer              - Customer hub (post jobs, order delivery, hire help)
/provider              - Provider hub (find work, manage gigs)
/provider-hub          - Provider dashboard (active jobs, wallet, Stripe Connect)
/real-estate           - Real estate listings
/autos                 - Vehicle marketplace
/restaurants           - Restaurant directory + delivery
/stores                - Retail directory + delivery
/rentals               - Rental marketplace

# Pricing
- Customer: pays the listed price + any delivery fee. No platform surcharge.
- Provider: receives 90% of every completed transaction. Lumo retains 10% commission.
- Providers can withdraw to a connected bank via Stripe (instant onboarding).
- 1% of every order is refunded to reviewers who leave honest feedback (cashback).

# Contact
hello@golumo.app
support@golumo.app
press@golumo.app

# Compliance
- FTC-compliant (no fake reviews — all testimonials are from verified customers)
- GDPR / DSA aware (EU customers can request data export/deletion)
- Stripe-backed PCI compliance for payments

# Crawl policy
Friendly to AI/LLM crawlers. Public read-only pages may be indexed and
quoted. Personal data, private dashboards, and admin pages are blocked
via robots.txt.
